lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information for Vietnam. The dataset contains approximately 1.2 million mapped buildings with an average data age of 3 years, representing approximately 5% of estimated total buildings based on AI-mapping estimates. Data are provided in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage) for integration into disaster risk assessments.
